blocks.en: Abstract
blocks.zh: 摘要

blocks.en:
Contrastive vision-language models map visual and textual representations into a shared normalized embedding space, making cosine similarity the natural metric for cross-modal retrieval. A practical challenge arises during model upgrades: independently trained models generally produce incompatible representation spaces, so replacing a deployed model typically requires recomputing embeddings for the entire gallery, which is prohibitively expensive at scale.
Orthogonal post-hoc alignment can partially mitigate this problem by mapping new-model queries into the old-model gallery space. However, because independently trained models can differ in fine-grained representation structure, the orthogonal alignment remains approximate, leaving a residual angular discrepancy between the old-model query and the aligned new-model query.
We study whether interpolation along the spherical geodesic between these two normalized query representations can improve retrieval without re-indexing the gallery.
We characterize when this path contains an interior query direction closer to an idealized retrieval-optimal direction than either endpoint, and connect this characterization to Recall@ K K through a local margin-based certification result.
Experiments across multiple benchmarks and model families show that post-alignment spherical interpolation improves over orthogonal alignment alone, recovering backward-compatibility in most evaluated settings.
Consistent with our geometric characterization, per-query oracle analysis shows that retrieval-favorable interior points occur frequently in practice. Code is available at https://github.com/miccunifi/SLERP_backward_compatibility .
blocks.zh:
相矛盾的视觉语言模型将视觉和文字表达图映射成一个共享的常态嵌入空间,使同位素相似性成为跨模式检索的自然尺度. 在模型升级过程中出现了一个实际挑战:经过独立训练的模型一般会产生不兼容的表示空间,因此替换一个部署的模型通常需要对整个画廊进行重新计算嵌入,而这种结构的规模太昂贵了。
整形后热量对齐可以通过将新模式的查询映射到旧模式的画廊空间来部分缓解这个问题. 然而,由于经过独立训练的模型在精细的表示结构上可能有所不同,正交配度仍然大致相同,使得旧模型查询和对齐的新模型查询之间留下了遗留的角差.
我们研究这两个正常的查询表达方式之间的球形大地测量的内插是否能改善检索,而无需重新索引画廊。
我们描述当此路径包含一个更接近理想化检索-优化方向的内置查询方向时, 并且通过基于本地边距的验证结果将这个特性连接到Recall@ K K.
跨越多个基准和模型家庭的实验表明,对齐后球形插值仅靠正弦对齐就能改善,在大多数被评价的环境下恢复后向兼容性.
与我们的几何特征一致的是,每条溪流分析显示,在实践中经常出现有利于检索的内部点。 代码见https://github.com/miccunifi/SLERP_backward_compatibility。

blocks.en: 1 Introduction
blocks.zh: 导言

blocks.en:
Contrastive vision-language models (VLMs) have become a standard foundation for multimodal retrieval and zero-shot classification [ 1 , 2 , 3 , 4 , 5 ] . By mapping images and text into a shared normalized embedding space, these models leverage cosine similarity for cross-modal retrieval and prompt-based classification.
As the ecosystem of pretrained models grows through public model releases and model hubs [ 6 , 7 , 8 ] , a practical question arises: how can a deployed retrieval system benefit from a stronger model without recomputing all embeddings produced by the old one?
blocks.zh:
相矛盾的视觉语言模型(VLMs)已经成为多式联运检索和零镜头分类的标准基础[1,2,3,4,5]. 这些模型通过将图像和文本映射到一个共享的正常嵌入空间,利用同位素相似性进行跨模式检索和即时分类。
随着预先训练过的模型的生态系统通过公共模型发布和模型集散中心[6,7,8]不断增长,产生了一个实际问题:一个部署的检索系统如何能够从一个更强大的模型中获益,而不重新计算旧模型所产生的所有嵌入物?

blocks.en:
This question is particularly important in large-scale retrieval systems. In many production deployments, galleries containing millions or billions of items have already been encoded and indexed, making index reconstruction after every model update computationally prohibitive [ 9 , 10 , 11 , 12 , 13 ] .
Moreover, re-indexing may be infeasible when the original raw data are no longer accessible due to privacy constraints, storage limitations, or data retention policies [ 14 , 15 , 16 ] . In such settings, backward-compatible upgrades that preserve the existing index may be the only viable option.
Even when re-indexing is feasible, progressive upgrades create a migration period requiring compatibility with the existing gallery.
blocks.zh:
这个问题在大规模检索系统中特别重要。 在许多生产部署中,包含数百万或数十亿物品的画廊已经编码和索引,使每个模型更新后的指数重建在计算上令人无法接受[9、10、11、12、13]。
此外,在原始原始数据由于隐私限制、存储限制或数据保留政策[14、15、16]而不再可访问时,重新索引可能不可行。 在这种情况下,保留现有指数的落后兼容升级可能是唯一可行的选择。
即使重新索引是可行的,渐进升级也创造了一个迁移期,需要与现有的画廊兼容.

blocks.en:
This compatibility challenge is increasingly common as advances in architectures, optimization, and training data drive frequent model upgrades [ 17 , 18 , 19 , 20 , 21 ] .
Yet such updates can compromise backward-compatibility [ 10 ] and alter the behavior of downstream applications in undesirable ways [ 10 , 22 , 11 , 15 , 23 , 24 , 25 , 26 ] .
Independently trained models rarely produce directly comparable representations [ 27 ] , so directly replacing a query encoder can break compatibility with an existing gallery. Backward-compatible training [ 10 ] addresses this issue by imposing restrictive constraints on the new-model training that can degrade its performance [ 28 , 29 ] .
A recent alternative is post-hoc alignment, which decouples model improvement from compatibility constraints by training the new model independently and restoring compatibility afterward through a lightweight mapping between representation spaces [ 12 , 13 , 30 ] .
This approach is motivated by the manifold hypothesis and related views on latent-space convergence, which suggest that functionally similar models may differ largely by simple transformations of a shared latent structure [ 31 , 32 , 33 , 34 , 30 ] .
blocks.zh:
这一兼容性挑战随着架构的进步,优化,以及培训数据驱动模式的频繁升级[17,18,19,20,21]而日益普遍.
然而,这种更新会损害向后兼容性[10],并以不可取的方式改变下游应用的行为[10、22、11、15、23、24、25、26]。
独立训练的模型很少产生可直接比较的表示[27],因此直接替换一个查询编码器可以打破与现有画廊的兼容性. 逆向兼容培训[10]解决这一问题,对新模式培训施加限制性限制,可降低其绩效[28,29]。
最近一种办法是Hoc后调整,通过独立培训新模型,使模型改进与兼容性限制脱钩,并通过在代表空间之间进行轻量级绘图,恢复兼容性[12、13、30]。
这种方法的动机是关于潜在空间趋同的多种假设和相关观点,这些假设和相关观点表明,功能上相似的模型可能在很大程度上因共享潜在结构的简单转变而不同[31、32、33、34、30]。

blocks.en:
For contrastive VLMs, orthogonal Procrustes provides a natural alignment map: embeddings are normalized and compared by cosine similarity, so the resulting orthogonal transformation preserves inner products and therefore the image–text geometry underlying retrieval and zero-shot classification [ 35 ] .
Moreover, agreement of the multimodal similarity kernel between independently trained contrastive VLMs identifies a single orthogonal map shared across image and text encoders, enabling cross-modal transfer of an alignment estimated from one modality [ 35 ] .
Related unimodal literature further supports orthogonal transformations over unconstrained linear maps, particularly when the new model is more informative, as an isometry preserves rather than distorts its discriminative geometry [ 33 , 36 , 30 ] .
However, independent training can induce representation differences that are not captured by a single global isometry.
Orthogonal post-hoc alignment is therefore approximate: the aligned new-model query embedding will not, in general, coincide with the embedding that the old model would have produced for the same input, especially when models share coarse semantic structure but differ in fine-grained organization [ 37 ] .
Consistent with this observation, Fig. 1 shows that a non-negligible residual angular mismatch remains after orthogonally aligning SigLIP2 to CLIP ViT-B/32, both on the alignment dataset and under zero-shot transfer.

此外,在经过独立培训的对比性VLM之间达成多式联运相似性内核协议,可确定在图像和文本编码器之间共享的单一正交图,从而能够从一种方式中进行估计的对齐的跨模式转移[35]。

Figure 1 : Residual discrepancy after orthogonal alignment from SigLIP2 to CLIP ViT-B/32. We show two complementary views: the distribution of residual angular mismatch between paired embeddings from the two models, and a 2D t-SNE projection of the corresponding feature spaces.
The remaining angular mismatch after alignment suggests that the orthogonal map leaves a residual cross-model gap, motivating a post-alignment interpolation strategy.

图1:从SigLIP2到CLIP VIT-B/32. 垂直对齐后的剩余差异。 我们显示了两种互补的观点:两个模型的配对嵌入体之间剩余角不匹配的分布,以及相应的特征空间的2D t-SNE投影.
对齐后剩下的角错配表明正交图留下了剩余的跨模型缺口,激发了对齐后插图策略.

blocks.en:
Motivated by the residual angular discrepancy, we treat the old-model query and the aligned new-model query as endpoints in a shared normalized representation space.
Rather than assuming that either endpoint is optimal for retrieval, we ask whether an intermediate direction along the spherical geodesic connecting them can be more effective against the old-model gallery.
Because retrieval is based on cosine similarity between normalized embeddings, the corresponding spherical interpolation is the minor geodesic between the two query directions. We parameterize this path using spherical linear interpolation (SLERP) [ 38 ] , which traverses the geodesic at constant angular speed and therefore gives the interpolation weight a consistent geometric interpretation across queries.
We formalize this intuition by considering an idealized retrieval-optimal query direction, used only as an analytical reference, and characterizing when the interpolation geodesic contains an interior point with a smaller angular gap to this direction than either endpoint. Geometrically, this occurs exactly when the normalized projection of the retrieval-optimal direction onto the interpolation plane lies in the relative interior of the arc; otherwise, the optimum along the arc is attained at an endpoint. We then connect this angular characterization to top- K K retrieval through a margin perturbation bound and a local Recall@ K K certification result.
blocks.zh:
在剩余角差异的推动下,我们将旧式查询和对齐的新式查询作为共享的常态化代表空间的终点.
我们不认为任何一个终点都是最佳的检索点,而是问,沿着球形大地测量线连接到这两个终点的中间方向是否能够对旧型画廊更加有效。
由于检索是基于常态嵌入物之间的余弦相似性,因此相应的球形内插是两个查询方向之间的小大地测量. 我们使用球形线性内插(SLERP)[38]参数化这个路径,它以恒定角速穿越大地测量,因此使内插加权在各种查询之间得到一致的几何解释.
我们通过考虑一种理想化的检索-优化查询方向,将这种直觉正式化,这种查询方向只用作分析参考,并描述当插值大地测量法包含一个内部点,这个方向的角间隙小于两个终点时。 从几何角度来说,这恰恰发生在将回收-优化方向正常投射到插值平面时,即位于弧的相对内层;否则,在端点上就达到了沿弧的最佳水平。 然后,我们通过边距扰动约束和本地调用@ K K K 认证结果,将这个角特性连接到顶端的 K 检索。

blocks.en:
We propose an approach that requires no model retraining or gradient-based optimization: the deployed gallery remains unchanged, while the new-model query is mapped into the old-model space by orthogonal Procrustes alignment and then interpolated with the old-model query using a fixed weight selected on the alignment support set.
Empirically, we evaluate backward-compatible cross-modal retrieval across multiple benchmarks and model families. Orthogonal alignment provides a useful shared coordinate system but often fails to achieve backward-compatibility on its own, whereas post-alignment spherical interpolation improves over orthogonal alignment and frequently restores compatibility.
Controlled ablations show that endpoint combination accounts for most of the mean retrieval improvement, while support-set weight selection primarily improves compatibility robustness. The weight selected on the same CC3M alignment support set used to estimate the Procrustes map transfers across retrieval datasets, achieving performance close to the per-dataset optimum without target-test tuning. A per-query oracle analysis, reported only as an upper bound, shows that retrieval-favorable interior positions occur frequently in practice; flip-rate analysis further reveals that the retrieval gains arise from a favorable balance between positive and negative retrieval flips. Finally, the approach remains effective when the gallery is re-indexed and in zero-shot classification.
blocks.zh:
我们提出一个不需要模型再培训或梯度优化的方法:所部署的画廊保持不变,而新模型的查询则通过正交Procrustes对齐绘制成旧模型空间,然后通过在对齐支持集上选择的固定权重与旧模型查询进行内插.
从经验上讲,我们评价跨多个基准和模范家庭的反向兼容跨模式检索。 正弦对接提供了有用的共享坐标系统,但往往无法单独实现后向兼容,而后向球形内插则比正弦对接有所改善,并经常恢复兼容性.
受控的缩放显示端点组合占了平均检索改进的大部分,而支持设置的重量选择主要提高兼容性强. 在用于估计Procrustes地图跨检索数据集传输的同一CC3M对齐支持集上选择的权重,在没有目标测试调试的情况下实现接近每个数据集最佳性能. 仅报告为上限的每股脉冲分析显示,在实践中经常出现有利于检索的内部位置;翻转率分析进一步显示,检索收益来自正反两方面的有利平衡。 最后,当画廊重新索引和零镜头分类时,这一方法仍然有效。

blocks.en: Our main contributions are: • We geometrically characterize when spherical interpolation between old-model and aligned new-model queries contains an interior direction closer to an idealized retrieval-optimal direction than either endpoint, and connect this characterization to top- K K retrieval. • We introduce a query-side approach for contrastive VLM upgrades that combines orthogonal Procrustes alignment with spherical interpolation, requiring neither model retraining nor gradient-based optimization, using a fixed interpolation weight selected on the alignment support set, while leaving the deployed gallery unchanged. • We validate the approach across CLIP, SigLIP1, and SigLIP2 on Flickr30k, COCO2014, and NoCaps, showing gains over orthogonal alignment and frequent backward-compatibility recovery. Ablations show that endpoint combination drives most of the improvement, while support-set weight selection transfers across datasets without target-test tuning.

Ablations show that endpoint combination drives most of the improvement, while support-set weight selection transfers across datasets without target-test tuning.

blocks.en: 2 Related Work
blocks.zh: 2 相关工作

blocks.en:
Backward-compatible representation learning. Backward-compatible training (BCT) [ 10 ] formalized how to upgrade a retrieval model without re-encoding a deployed gallery by requiring embeddings from the new model to remain directly comparable with those of the old one. Subsequent work extended this paradigm through class- and prototype-level alignment [ 11 ] , neighborhood-level compatibility constraints [ 39 ] , open-set and universal formulations [ 14 ] , regression-aware hot-refresh updates [ 40 ] , basis expansion [ 28 ] , stationary representations [ 41 , 15 , 42 ] , and orthogonal transformation layers [ 29 ] .
In particular, stationary representations learned with d d -Simplex fixed classifiers [ 43 ] , the geometry that also emerges under neural collapse [ 44 ] , provably satisfy the inequality constraints of the formal compatibility definition in unimodal retrieval [ 26 ] .
Other works relax the uniform compatibility requirement through selective compatibility [ 45 ] , hyperbolic embeddings constrained by entailment cones [ 46 ] , or perturbed prototype targets that preserve discriminative structure while maintaining interoperability [ 47 ] . Recent work also shows that hyperspherical simplex representations derived for classifier outputs can be inherently backward-compatible and satisfy the formal definition of backward compatibility on average [ 48 ] . Related lifelong formulations have been studied in image-to-image retrieval and person re-identification, where compatibility avoids re-indexing across sequential updates [ 49 , 50 , 42 , 15 ] .
However, most of this literature addresses unimodal model upgrades. For vision-language models, XBT [ 51 ] extends backward-compatible learning to cross-modal retrieval by learning a projection module, pretraining it on text, injecting Gaussian noise, and fine-tuning the new VLM with LoRA using both text and image data. While effective, this requires a dedicated training pipeline with large text and image–text corpora. In contrast, our approach requires no model retraining or gradient-based optimization: it estimates an orthogonal Procrustes map from a small alignment support set and performs query-side interpolation without modifying either model or re-indexing the gallery.
blocks.zh:
后进相配的代表学习. 后向兼容训练(BCT)[10] 正式规定如何在不重新编码已部署的画廊的情况下升级检索模型,要求新模型的嵌入物保持与旧模型的直接可比性. 随后的工作通过类与原型级对齐[11],邻域级兼容性约束[39],开放设置和通用配方[14],回归意识热-再更新[40],基础扩展[28],固定表示[41,15,42],正交转化层[29],扩展了这一范式.
特别是用d-Simplex固定分类器学习的固定表示法,神经崩溃下也出现的几何特征[44],可以证明满足了单模式检索中形式兼容性定义的不平等限制[26].
其他作品通过选择性兼容[45],双曲嵌入受内置锥[46]制约,或扰动原型目标在保持互操作性的同时保留歧视结构[47],放松统一兼容性要求. 最近的工作还表明,为分类器输出而衍生的超球形简单x表示可以内在的向后兼容,并且平均满足对向后兼容的正式定义[48]. 相关的终身配方在图像到图像检索和人员重新识别方面进行了研究,兼容性避免了连续更新的重新索引[49、50、42、15]。
然而,这些文献大多涉及单模式升级。 对于视觉语言模型,XBT [51]通过学习一个投影模块,对文本进行预训,注入高斯噪音,以及利用文本和图像数据对新的VLM进行微调,将后向兼容的学习扩展到跨模式检索. 这需要专门的训练管道, 相反,我们的方法不需要模式再培训或基于梯度的优化:它估计一个正交 从一个小的对齐支持集中解析地图,并在不修改模型或重新索引画廊的情况下进行查询侧插值.

blocks.en:
Model interpolation. Interpolation has been studied extensively in parameter space through mode connectivity, weight averaging, model soups, permutation-aware merging, and task arithmetic [ 52 , 53 , 54 , 55 , 56 , 57 , 58 ] .
Recent works also use spherical interpolation, but for different objects and objectives.
In zero-shot composed image retrieval, [ 59 ] uses SLERP to combine image and text embeddings into a composed query, together with text-anchored tuning. WARP [ 60 ] , by contrast, applies SLERP in policy weight space to merge independently fine-tuned language-model policies, improving reward while controlling deviation from a reference policy.
Unlike these works, we apply spherical interpolation on the query side for backward-compatible retrieval, interpolating between the old-model query and the Procrustes-aligned new-model query for the same input. We characterize when the resulting minor geodesic contains an interior direction closer to an idealized retrieval-optimal direction than either endpoint, and connect this geometry to Recall@ K K through margin-based guarantees.
blocks.zh:
模式内插. 通过模式互联互通,体重平均,模型汤,穿透-知觉合并,任务算术[52,53,54,55,56,57,58],对参数空间进行了广泛研究.
近期的作品也使用球形插图,但针对不同的对象和目标.

与这些作品不同的是,我们在查询侧面应用球形插图进行后向兼容检索,在旧式查询和Procrustes-accessed新式查询之间插图进行相同的输入. 我们描述所形成的小大地测量在内部方向上比两个终点更接近理想化的检索-最佳方向时,并通过差值保证将这一几何与Recall@K K连接起来。

Theorem 1 shows that the endpoint separation θ \theta alone does not determine whether interpolation yields an interior angular improvement.
The decisive quantity is the position of the normalized in-plane projection of q ∗ q^{\ast} relative to the minor arc.
If this direction lies in the relative interior of the arc, the geodesic contains an interior query closer to q ∗ q^{\ast} than either endpoint; otherwise, the optimum along the arc is attained at an endpoint.
Appendix F connects this angular characterization to Recall@ K K by instantiating q ∗ q^{\ast} as a top- K K -margin-optimal direction.
A margin perturbation bound then specifies when angular proximity to this direction locally certifies Recall@ K K success.
Thus, Theorem 1 characterizes when interpolation improves the angular retrieval gap, while the margin result determines when this improvement is sufficient for the discrete top- K K retrieval event.

blocks.en: 4 Experimental Results
blocks.zh: 4 实验结果

blocks.en:
We evaluate whether post-alignment spherical interpolation improves backward-compatible retrieval after mapping the new model into the old-model coordinate system with orthogonal Procrustes alignment.
Because the alignment is obtained in closed form from a singular value decomposition (Sec. 3 ), we refer to it as SVD throughout this paper.
The main experiments focus on cross-modal retrieval with a fixed old-model gallery, while Appendix G reports an auxiliary zero-shot classification evaluation with fixed old-model text prototypes.
blocks.zh:
我们评价在将新模型映射到旧模型坐标系统后,与正弦Procrustes对齐后,后方球形插图是否改善了向后兼容的检索.
由于对齐是通过单值分解(sec. 3)得到的闭合形式,我们在整个本文中将其称为SVD.
主要实验侧重于用固定的旧型画廊进行跨模式检索,而附录G则报告用固定的旧型文本原型进行辅助零镜头分类评价.

blocks.en: 4.1 Experimental Setup
blocks.zh: 4.1 实验设置

blocks.en:
We evaluate the proposed approach across CLIP, SigLIP1, and SigLIP2 vision-language models.
To cover both same-family and cross-family upgrades, we use OpenAI CLIP ViT-B/32 and ViT-L/14 [ 1 ] , CLIP ViT-H/14 [ 62 ] , SigLIP1 ViT-SO400M-14 [ 3 ] , and SigLIP2 ViT-SO400M-14 [ 5 ] .
These produce embeddings of 512 (CLIP ViT-B/32), 768 (CLIP ViT-L/14), 1024 (CLIP ViT-H/14), and 1152 (SigLIP1/2) dimensions, covering equal- and unequal-dimensional model pairs.
Including SigLIP-family models allows us to assess whether the residual post-alignment discrepancy and the gains from spherical interpolation extend beyond CLIP-family representation geometry to models trained with different objectives.
All checkpoints are obtained from the OpenCLIP repository [ 63 ] .
blocks.zh:
我们评价了拟议的整个CLIP、SigLIP1和SigLIP2远景语言模型。
为了覆盖同家族和跨家族升级,我们使用OpenAI CLIP ViT-B/32和VIT-L/14 [1],CLIP ViT-H/14 [62],SigLIP1 ViT-SO400M-14 [3],以及SigLIP2 ViT-SO400M-14 [5].
这些产品嵌入了512(CLIP ViT-B/32),768(CLIP ViT-L/14),1024(CLIP ViT-H/14),以及1152(SigLIP1/2)维度,涵盖了等维度和不平等度模型对.
包括SigLIP-family模型,使我们能够评估剩余对齐后差异和球形插值收益是否超出CLIP-family代表几何学的范围,以及训练有不同目标的模型.
所有检查站均从OpenCLIP仓库获得[63].

blocks.en:
For each old–new model pair, we estimate the Procrustes map from
12,637 available image–text pairs from the CC3M [ 64 ] validation split, which serves as the alignment support set.
We consider three support-modality choices: text-only, image-only, and joint image–text support, where the joint setting stacks embeddings from both modalities before solving the Procrustes problem.
Motivated by [ 35 ] , these variants test whether a single modality is sufficient to estimate the orthogonal map and whether combining modalities yields more stable cross-modal transfer.

每对新旧模型,我们估计Procrustes地图来自
12,637个可用图像 - 文本对来自 CC3M [64] 验证拆分,这作为对齐支持集.
我们考虑三种支持模式选择:仅文本、仅图像和联合图像文本支持,其中联合设置堆栈从两种模式中嵌入,然后解决Procrustes问题。
以[35]为动机,这些变式检验单一模式是否足以估计正交图,合并模式是否产生更稳定的跨模式转让。

blocks.en:
We evaluate backward-compatible retrieval, comparing the training-based XBT baseline [ 51 ] , three Procrustes support-modality variants, and SLERP applied after each alignment.
Old- and new-model performance are included as reference points.
For SLERP, α = 0 \alpha=0 corresponds to the old-model query, while α = 1 \alpha=1 corresponds to the SVD-aligned new-model query, i.e., the SVD baseline.
For each old–new model pair, the Procrustes map is estimated and the interpolation weight α ^ \hat{\alpha} is selected on the same CC3M alignment support set.
Separate weights are selected for image-to-text (I2T) and text-to-image (T2I) retrieval by maximizing CC3M Recall@1 over α ∈ { 0 , 0.1 , … , 1.0 } \alpha\in\{0,0.1,\ldots,1.0\} .
These model-pair- and retrieval-direction-specific weights are then fixed for
evaluation on three cross-modal retrieval benchmarks, following the large-scale
protocol of XBT [ 51 ] : the full Flickr30k dataset [ 65 ] (the union of the Karpathy splits [ 66 ] ), and the validation splits of COCO 2014 [ 67 ] and NoCaps [ 68 ] .
We additionally report the benchmark-specific oracle weight α ⋆ \alpha^{\star} , selected directly on each test benchmark solely as an upper-bound reference.

blocks.en: 4.3 Compatibility Results
blocks.zh: 4.3 兼容性结果

blocks.en:
Tables 1 and 2 report cross-modal compatible retrieval results for same-family and cross-family model pairs, respectively.
Across 90 evaluations—five model pairs, three support modalities, three datasets, and both retrieval directions—CC3M-selected SLERP satisfies the Recall@1 compatibility criterion in Eq. 15 in 85 cases, compared with 45 for SVD alone.
The additional model-pair results included in this aggregate, together with the full Recall@1/5/10 results, are reported in Appendix I .
SVD thus provides an effective post-hoc alignment but does not consistently satisfy the compatibility criterion, particularly for cross-family pairs.
This is consistent with the residual angular discrepancy in Fig. 1 : Procrustes alignment maps new representations into the old-model coordinate system but does not fully resolve the cross-model mismatch.
blocks.zh:
表1和表2分别报告了同家和跨家模式对等的跨模式兼容检索结果。
共有90项评价——5项模式对、3项支助模式、3项数据集和2项检索方向——CC3M选定的SLERP在85个案例中符合Eq.15中的Recall@1兼容性标准,而单SVD就达到45个。
附录一报告了列入这一总数的其他模型-页码结果,以及全部召回@1/5/10结果。
因此,SVD提供了有效的Hoc后对齐,但并不一贯满足兼容性标准,特别是对于跨家族配对.
这与法格中剩余的角差异是一致的. 1:Procrustes 校正图将新的表示方式映射到旧模式坐标系统中,但不能完全解决跨模式错配.

blocks.en:
For same-family upgrades, our approach remains competitive with available XBT results without any specific compatibility training.
In the harder SigLIP1 → \rightarrow CLIP ViT-H/14 setting, where the new model is not uniformly stronger than the old one, SLERP still achieves compatibility in most cases.
These results suggest that the gains arise from combining old and SVD-aligned new representations, rather than solely from a stronger new encoder. Fig. 3 illustrates this behavior for T2I Recall@1, with performance often maximized at an interior interpolation weight.
The CC3M-selected α ^ \hat{\alpha} closely tracks the dataset-specific oracle α ⋆ \alpha^{\star} , showing that a single support-set-selected weight transfers to Flickr30k, COCO, and NoCaps without test-set tuning.
blocks.zh:
对于同一家庭的升级,我们的方法仍然与现有的XBT结果具有竞争力,而没有任何具体的兼容性培训。
在较硬的SigLIP1 ~\右旋CLIP VIT-H/14设置中,新模型比旧模型不统一,在大多数情况下SLERP仍然实现兼容性.
这些结果表明,收益来自将旧的和SVD相适应的新表述结合起来,而不是仅仅来自一个更强大的新编码器。 图3说明了T2I Recall@1的这一行为,性能经常在内部插值重量时最大化.
CC3M-select α ^ hat\alpha} 密切跟踪数据集特有的甲骨文 α → α \ alpha^{\star}, 显示一个单一支持- set-set-select gar 传输到 Flickr30k, COCO, 和 NoCaps 没有测试-set调制.

blocks.en:
Appendix H reports the corresponding I2T curves, which show the same pattern.
Across different support set modalities, text-only alignment is the most stable choice overall.
Image-only support, as in [ 35 ] , and joint support remain competitive in individual cases, but text embeddings appear to provide cleaner semantic anchors for estimating the old–new alignment.
Moreover, Appendix M provides a complementary per-query oracle analysis on Flickr30k I2T retrieval for CLIP ViT-L/14 → \rightarrow CLIP ViT-B/32.
Among queries achieving Recall@1 at some evaluated interpolation weight, 97.65 % 97.65\% are assigned an interior oracle weight. The oracle uses query-level test labels and is therefore non-deployable, it provides observable evidence consistent with the geometric characterization in Sec. 3 : retrieval-favorable query representations frequently occur in the interior of the interpolation arc rather than at either endpoint.
Appendix J further shows that SLERP often improves over the new model even when re-indexing is allowed, indicating that the benefit of interpolation is not limited to the compatibility-only setting.

在整个不同的支持设定模式中,仅文本对齐是总体最稳定的选择.
仅图像支持,如[35],联合支持在个别情况下仍然具有竞争力,但文本嵌入似乎为估计旧的-新配对提供了更清洁的语义锚.

blocks.en:
Additionally, in Appendix K we evaluate the setting in which a small subset from the target test distribution is available for estimating the SLERP weight. The results show that even a modest subset is sufficient to select a reliable dataset-specific interpolation weight.
We further show in Appendix N that the gains are not specific to SLERP: a fixed normalized midpoint, support-set selected NLERP, and score interpolation yield comparable average improvements. We use SLERP for its constant-angular-speed parameterization, which gives the interpolation weight a consistent geometric interpretation across queries.

Flip analysis. Fig. 4 decomposes the T2I Recall@1 change along the interpolation path into positive and negative flips relative to old-to-old retrieval.
Since Δ ​ R ​ @ ​ 1 = PFR − NFR \Delta\mathrm{R@1}=\mathrm{PFR}-\mathrm{NFR} , the optimal interpolation weight is determined by the balance between the two rates rather than by positive flips alone.
Moving from the old-model query toward the aligned new-model query initially corrects more old-model failures than it introduces regressions; beyond the optimum, negative flips grow faster than positive ones and the gain decreases.
For CLIP ViT-H/14 → \rightarrow CLIP ViT-B/32, where SVD alignment alone already exceeds the old model, the gain peaks close to the SVD endpoint ( α ⋆ = 0.7 \alpha^{\star}=0.7 ). In both cases, the CC3M-selected α ^ \hat{\alpha} lies near the peak.

blocks.en: 5 Conclusion
blocks.zh: 5 结论

blocks.en:
We studied the problem of upgrading contrastive vision-language retrieval systems without re-encoding the deployed gallery.
Motivated by the residual angular discrepancy left by orthogonal post-hoc alignment, we proposed a query-side approach that first maps new-model queries into the old-model representation space through orthogonal Procrustes alignment and then interpolates them with the corresponding old-model queries along the spherical geodesic.
Our analysis characterizes when this interpolation path contains an interior direction closer to an idealized retrieval-optimal direction than either endpoint, and connects this angular improvement to Recall@ K K through a local margin-based sufficient condition.
Empirically, we validated the method across CLIP, SigLIP1, and SigLIP2 upgrades, covering same-family and cross-family pairs and Flickr30k, COCO, and NoCaps retrieval benchmarks.
SLERP improves over SVD alignment in nearly all settings, often restores empirical backward-compatibility, and frequently matches or surpasses training-based compatibility baselines while requiring no compatibility training.
The support-set selected interpolation weights transfer reliably across datasets, and additional evaluations show that the same mechanism also extends to re-indexed retrieval and zero-shot classification.
Overall, these results show that residual post-alignment geometry contains useful retrieval signal and that post-alignment interpolation provides a simple and effective mechanism for backward-compatible vision-language model upgrades.
blocks.zh:
我们研究了在不重新编码已部署的画廊的情况下更新对比性视觉语言检索系统的问题。
受正交后对齐留下的余角差异的驱使,我们提出了查询边方法,首先通过正交Procrustes对齐将新模型的查询映射到旧模型的代表空间,然后在球形大地测量仪上与相应的旧模型查询进行插值.
我们的分析描述的是,当这种内插路径包含一个比两个终点都更接近理想化的检索-优化方向的内向时,通过一个基于本地边距的足够条件,将这一角化改进与Recall@KK连接起来。
从经验上讲,我们验证了CLIP、SigLIP1和SigLIP2的升级方法,涵盖同族和跨族对联以及Flickr30k、COCO和NoCaps检索基准。
在几乎所有场合,SLERP都比SVD对齐有所改进,往往恢复经验性的后向兼容性,经常匹配或超过基于培训的兼容性基线,同时不需要兼容性培训.
支持设置的选定插值加权数在数据集之间可靠地转移,其他评价显示,同一机制也延伸到重新索引的检索和零镜头分类。
总体来看,这些结果表明,剩余后调图几何包含有用的检索信号,后调图插图为落后兼容的视觉语言模型升级提供了简单有效的机制.

blocks.en:
Limitations. SLERP also involves practical trade-offs, discussed in Appendix O : the interpolation weight must be selected on a support set, query-side inference requires both endpoint embeddings, and performance remains bounded by the quality and complementarity of the available representations.
In our experiments, these trade-offs are favorable, suggesting that spherical interpolation provides a simple, robust approach for upgrading contrastive vision-language retrieval systems while preserving backward-compatibility. Moreover, it provides a compatibility mechanism during model migration, allowing the deployed gallery to remain usable while full re-indexing is deferred or performed offline, as described in Appendix P .
blocks.zh:
限制。 SLERP还涉及实际的权衡,附录O讨论:插值权重必须在一个支持集上选择,查询侧推论要求同时嵌入端点,性能仍受可用表述的质量和互补性的限制.
在我们的实验中,这些权衡是有利的,这表明球形插值提供了一种简单,有力的方法来提升对比性视觉语言检索系统,同时保持后向兼容性. 此外,它提供了一个在模型迁移过程中的兼容机制,使部署的通道能够继续使用,同时如附录P所述,全面重新索引被推迟或离线。

blocks.en: Appendix A Additional Related Work

blocks.en:
Post-hoc alignment and cross-model correspondence. A complementary line of work studies whether the latent spaces of independently trained models can be aligned after training, without modifying the original model weights. Classical manifold alignment and Procrustes methods provide the foundation for this approach by seeking simple correspondences between representation spaces, either from paired anchors or by preserving the geometric structure of the underlying data manifolds [ 69 , 70 , 71 , 72 , 73 ] . The central assumption is that independently trained models may encode similar semantic structure in different coordinate systems; consequently, a lightweight post-hoc transformation can often make their representations comparable. Recent work supports this view in latent representation spaces, showing that useful cross-model correspondences can be recovered through semantic latent translation and latent functional maps [ 33 , 34 ] . These results suggest that exact equality between representation spaces is not required for interoperability—a transformation that preserves the task-relevant structure shared across models can be sufficient.
This perspective is consistent with broader evidence that independently trained models can develop similar representation geometry across architectures and modalities [ 27 , 32 ] . However, such convergence is generally approximate rather than exact, and recent results indicate that cross-modal agreement may weaken at realistic scales and in many-to-many settings [ 37 ] . Most closely related to our setting, [ 35 ] shows that independently trained contrastive VLMs can often be approximately canonicalized by a single orthogonal map shared across modalities, estimated from a small anchor set and without retraining either model. Recent work further extends this viewpoint beyond pairwise alignment by constructing a shared orthogonal reference space across multiple models and applying a retrieval-oriented correction [ 74 ] . These works support the assumption that a new-model query can be mapped into the coordinate system of the deployed gallery model with post-hoc orthogonal alignment. Our work focuses on the angular discrepancy after this alignment step: even in a common coordinate system, embeddings of the same input may differ due to architecture, training data (e.g., label noise and long-tailed class distributions [ 75 ] ), optimization, or inductive bias, and may therefore induce different rankings over the same fixed gallery. We study this residual discrepancy directly by characterizing when spherical interpolation between the old-model query and the aligned new-model query improves retrieval.
blocks.zh:
后浩克对齐和跨型通信. 一项补充性的工作研究是,独立培训的模型的潜在空间是否可以在培训后调整,而不修改原来的模型权重。 古典式的多重对齐和Procrustes方法为这种方法提供了基础,通过在代表空间之间寻求简单的对应,或者从配对锚上,或者通过保留基础数据多重的几何结构[69、70、71、72、73]。 中心假设是,独立训练的模型可以将相似的语义结构编码到不同的坐标系统中;因此,轻量级的后热转换往往能使它们的表达具有可比性. 近期的工作支持了潜在表达空间中的这一观点,表明有用的跨模型函证可以通过语义上的潜在翻译和潜在功能地图[33,34]恢复. 这些结果表明,互操作性不需要代表空间之间的完全平等——保持各模型之间共享的任务相关结构的转变就足够了。
这种观点与更广泛的证据是一致的,即经过独立培训的模型可以发展出各种建筑和模式的类似代表几何[27,32]. 然而,这种趋同一般是大致的,而不是准确的,最近的结果表明,在现实规模和许多情况下,跨模式协议可能会削弱[37]。 与我们的设定最密切相关的是,[35] 表明,经过独立培训的对比性VLM往往可以大致由各模式共享的单一正交图进行划线化,从一个小型锚地集中估算,而无需再培训任何一种模式。 近期的工作进一步扩展了这一观点,超越了对等对齐,在多个模型之间构建了共享的正交参考空间,并采用了面向检索的校正[74]. 这些作品支持这样的假设,即新模式的查询可以被映射到已部署的画廊模型的坐标系统中,并带有hoc orthogonal后对齐. 我们的工作侧重于这个对齐步骤之后的角差异:即使在一个共同的坐标系统中,同一输入的嵌入也可能由于架构,训练数据(如标签噪声和长尾类分布[75]),优化,或诱导偏差而不同,因此可能诱导在同一固定画廊上进行不同的排名. 我们直接通过描述旧式查询和对齐的新式查询之间的球形插值改善检索时来研究这一剩余差异.

blocks.en: A related line of work combines independently trained embedding models directly in parameter space. In particular, [ 76 ] studies model merging for general text embeddings by searching over combinations of task vectors, including SLERP-based interpolation; unlike our setting, this operates in model-parameter space and assumes models with the same architecture, whereas we interpolate query representations after cross-model alignment.
blocks.zh: 相关的一行工作将独立训练的嵌入模型直接结合到参数空间中. 特别是,[76]研究模型通过搜索任务矢量的组合,包括基于SLERP的插值来合并一般文本嵌入;这与我们的设置不同,它运行在模型参数空间中,并假设模型具有相同的结构,而我们在跨模型对齐后插值查询表示.

blocks.en:
Geometry of contrastive vision-language spaces. Our analysis builds on work showing that contrastive VLMs learn a normalized image–text embedding space in which cross-modal comparisons are performed by cosine similarity, but whose geometry is not fully homogeneous or modality-invariant [ 1 , 77 ] .
Prior work shows that image and text embeddings can occupy separated regions of the representation space, leading to modality gaps [ 78 , 79 ] . Other studies identify intra-modal misalignment within individual encoders [ 80 ] , as well as spectral decompositions into approximately isotropic shared components and anisotropic modality-specific directions [ 81 ] . Recent work further suggests that InfoNCE-trained representations may exhibit approximately Gaussian embedding distributions [ 82 ] .
Together, these findings indicate that global comparability does not imply full geometric equivalence: a common coordinate system may preserve cross-modal similarity while still retaining model-specific or modality-specific structure. This perspective helps explain why an alignment estimated from one modality can transfer to the other [ 35 ] , while also leaving residual angular discrepancies after alignment. In our setting, this residual angular structure is precisely the object of interest, and it motivates interpolation between the old-model query and the aligned new-model query.
blocks.zh:
对比视觉语言空间几何. 我们的分析基于以下工作:对比的VLM学习了一种普通的图像-文本嵌入空间,其中跨模式比较是通过余弦相似性进行的,但其几何学并非完全一致或模式-变量[1,77]。
以前的工作显示,图像和文字嵌入可以占据代表空间的分离区域,导致模式差距[78,79]. 其他研究查明了单个编码器内部的模式内错配[80],以及光谱分解成大约同位素共享组件和异位素模式特定方向[81]. 最近的工作进一步表明,InfoNCE训练过的演示可能显示大约高斯嵌入式分布[82].
这些调查结果表明,全球可比性并不意味着完全的几何等同性:一个共同的坐标系统可以保持跨模式的相似性,同时仍然保留模式特定或模式特定的结构。 这一视角有助于解释为什么从一种模式估计的对齐可以转移到另一种模式[35],同时在对齐后留下剩余的角差异. 在我们的设定中,这种残留角结构恰恰是感兴趣的对象,它激发了旧模式查询和对齐的新模式查询之间的内插.

Appendix C Relationship Between SLERP and NLERP
blocks.zh: 附录C 在SLERP和NLERP之间

blocks.en:
This appendix clarifies the relationship between spherical linear interpolation (SLERP) and normalized linear interpolation (NLERP) in our setting.
Both methods can interpolate between the same two normalized query endpoints: the old-model query embedding u u and the SVD-aligned new-model query embedding v v , with θ = ∠ ⁡ ( u , v ) ∈ ( 0 , π ) \theta=\angle(u,v)\in(0,\pi) .
The difference is not the set of directions that can be reached, but the way in which the interpolation path is parameterized.
blocks.zh:
本附录澄清了球形线性插值(SLERP)与正常线性插值(NLERP)在我们设置中的关系.
两种方法都可以在相同的两个正常的查询端点之间插上: 旧式查询嵌入u u 和 SVD 相配的新式查询嵌入 v ,其中 θ = ∠ ⁡ (u, v) ∈ (0, π)\theta=\angle(u, v)\in(0,\pi).
不同之处不是可以达到的一组方向,而是内插路径的参数化方式.

(43) By contrast, NLERP first takes a Euclidean convex combination of the two endpoints and then renormalizes it: q β nlerp = ( 1 − β ) ​ u + β ​ v ‖ ( 1 − β ) ​ u + β ​ v ‖ 2 , β ∈ [ 0 , 1 ] . q^{\mathrm{nlerp}}_{\beta}=\frac{(1-\beta)u+\beta v}{\|(1-\beta)u+\beta v\|_{2}},\qquad\beta\in[0,1]. (44) Thus, NLERP also remains on the unit sphere, but its interpolation weight does not correspond to constant angular motion along the arc.

The unnormalized NLERP numerator can then be written as ( 1 − β ) ​ u + β ​ v = ( 1 − β + β ​ cos ⁡ θ ) ​ e 1 + β ​ sin ⁡ θ ​ e 2 . (48) Moreover, d ​ τ d ​ β = sin ⁡ θ ‖ ( 1 − β ) ​ u + β ​ v ‖ 2 2 > 0 , \frac{d\tau}{d\beta}=\frac{\sin\theta}{\|(1-\beta)u+\beta v\|_{2}^{2}}>0, (49) so τ ⁡ ( β ) \tau(\beta) is strictly increasing on [ 0 , 1 ] [0,1] .
Consequently, NLERP traces exactly the same minor geodesic arc as SLERP, but under a monotone reparameterization.
Conversely, the inverse mapping from a SLERP weight α \alpha to the NLERP weight that reaches the same direction is β ⁡ ( α ) = sin ⁡ ( α ​ θ ) sin ⁡ ( ( 1 − α ) ​ θ ) + sin ⁡ ( α ​ θ ) . \beta(\alpha)=\frac{\sin(\alpha\theta)}{\sin((1-\alpha)\theta)+\sin(\alpha\theta)}. (50)

This equivalence has an immediate implication for continuous weight selection.
For any retrieval objective that depends only on the resulting query direction, optimizing over α ∈ [ 0 , 1 ] \alpha\in[0,1] with SLERP and optimizing over β ∈ [ 0 , 1 ] \beta\in[0,1] with NLERP search over the same set of unit vectors.
Thus, in the continuous setting, the two methods have the same optimal directions.
The distinction is instead geometric and practical: SLERP moves at constant angular speed, since ∠ ⁡ ( u , q α slerp ) = α ​ θ \angle(u,q^{\mathrm{slerp}}_{\alpha})=\alpha\theta , whereas NLERP moves non-uniformly along the same arc.
Using SLERP therefore makes the interpolation weight directly interpretable as a normalized angular displacement from the old-model query toward the SVD-aligned new-model query.
blocks.zh:
这种等效性对连续重量选择具有直接的影响。
对任何只取决于由此产生的查询方向的检索目标,优化了 α [0, 1]\ alpha\ in [0, 1] 与 SLERP 相比,并优化了 β [0, 1]\ beta\ in [0, 1] 与 NLERP 在同一组单元向量上搜索.
因此,在连续环境下,两种方法具有相同的最佳方向.
区别是几何和实际的: SLERP以恒角速度移动,因为 QQ(u, q α slerp ) = α\angle(u, q^{\ mathrm{slerp}}_{\alpha}) =\alpha\theta, 而 NLERP 沿着同一个弧线移动非统一形式 。
因此,使用 SLERP 使插值权重可以直接解释为从旧式查询到SVD与新式查询的正常角移。

blocks.en:
Fig. 5 empirically compares SLERP and NLERP on Flickr30k and COCO retrieval after SVD alignment.
The two curves are nearly identical across the interpolation path and achieve their best performance in the same interior region of the arc.
The small visible differences are consistent with the reparameterization above: a uniform grid in the NLERP weight β \beta is not a uniform grid in angular position, and therefore does not sample exactly the same directions as a uniform grid in the SLERP weight α \alpha .
Overall, this comparison supports our use of SLERP not because it accesses a different family of query representations, but because it provides a geometrically canonical parameterization of the same interpolation arc.
blocks.zh:
图5 在Flickr30k和COCO比对SVD后对SLERP和NLERP进行经验比较.
横跨插座路径的两条曲线几乎完全相同,并在弧形的同一内地区实现最佳性能.
细微的可见差异与上面的重新参数化一致: NLERP重量β\ββ中的统一网格在角位置上不是统一的网格,因此在SLERP重量α\α中与统一的网格没有完全相同的采样方向.
总的来说,这种比较支持我们使用SLERP,不是因为它访问不同的查询表示的家族,而是因为它提供了同一插值弧的几何线条参数化.

blocks.en:
Figure 5 : Empirical comparison of SLERP and NLERP for text-only image-to-text retrieval after SVD alignment.
The columns correspond to the two source-target model pairs: CLIP ViT-L/14 → \rightarrow CLIP ViT-B/32 on the left and SigLIP2 → \rightarrow CLIP ViT-B/32 on the right.
The rows correspond to the two retrieval datasets: Flickr30k on the top row and COCO on the bottom row.
Across Flickr30k and COCO, and for both source-model pairs, the two interpolation schemes trace nearly identical retrieval curves and attain their best performance in the same interior region of the interpolation path.
The small discrepancies arise because a uniform grid in the NLERP weight does not correspond to a uniform grid in angular position along the shared geodesic arc.
This supports using SLERP as a geometrically canonical parameterization rather than as a different family of query representations.

图5:SLERP和NLERP在SVD对齐后用于仅文本图像到文本检索的经验比较.
列对应两个源目标型号对:CLIP VIT-L/14 →\右翼CLIP VIT-B/32左侧和SigLIP2 →\右翼CLIP VIT-B/32右侧.
该行对应两个检索数据集:Flickr30k在上行,COCO在下行.
在Flickr30k和COCO两处,对于两个源模型对子,两个插值方案追踪几乎相同的检索曲线,并在同一内地插值路径上取得最佳业绩。
出现小差异的原因是,NLERP重量中的统一网格与共享大地测量弧上角位置的统一网格不符。
这支持使用SLERP作为几何词条参数化,而不是不同的查询表示家族.

blocks.en: Appendix G Cross-Modal Zero-shot Classification
blocks.zh: 附录G 零镜头分类

blocks.en:
We evaluate zero-shot classification as an auxiliary evaluation setting.
Class text prototypes are encoded by the old-model text encoder using the template ‘‘A photo of a <class_name>’’ and kept fixed.
Image embeddings are obtained from the new model either directly via SVD alignment or by applying SLERP to the SVD-aligned embeddings, then compared against the fixed old-model prototypes.
Thus, only the image side changes, while the text-prototype side remains in the old-model space.
blocks.zh:
我们评价零镜头分类作为辅助评价设置.
类文本原型由老式文本编码器使用模板 QQA 照片的 < class_name_QQ> 进行编码,并保持固定.
从新模型中直接通过SVD对齐或通过将SLERP应用到SVD对齐的嵌入上,然后与固定的旧模型原型相比,获得图像嵌入.
因此,只有图像的侧面会改变,而文本原型的侧面则留在旧模型空间中.

blocks.en:
For classification, the Procrustes alignment is estimated on ImageNet-1K [ 83 ] validation set using text-only support.
The SLERP weight α ^ \hat{\alpha} is selected on ImageNet validation top-1 accuracy and then fixed for evaluation on Cars, Pets, Flowers, Aircraft, DTD, EuroSAT, Food101, SUN397, Caltech101, and UCF101.
For SLERP, α = 0 \alpha=0 corresponds to old-model image embeddings, while α = 1 \alpha=1 corresponds to SVD-aligned new-model image embeddings.
We also report α ⋆ \alpha^{\star} , the dataset-specific oracle weight, as an upper-bound reference.

对于分类,Procrustes 校正在ImageNet-1K [83] 验证集上使用仅文本支持估算.
SLERP重量 α ^\ hat\ alpha}是在ImageNet验证最高精度上选择的,然后固定在汽车、宠物、花卉、飞机、DTD、EuroSAT、Food101、SUN397、Caltech101和UCF101.
对于SLERP,α = 0\alpha=0对应旧型图像嵌入,而α = 1\alpha=1对应SVD对齐的新型图像嵌入.

blocks.en: Tab. 3 shows that SVD alignment alone recovers a meaningful fraction of the old-model classifier’s accuracy, but remains lower on average. Applying SLERP to the SVD-aligned embeddings consistently improves this endpoint, often closing the gap to, or even surpassing, the old-model classifier. This trend mirrors the retrieval results: SVD provides a useful but approximate alignment between the two model representations, while SLERP yields a more effective representation in the old-model space.

blocks.en: Appendix I Detailed Retrieval Performance
blocks.zh: 附录一 详细检索性能

blocks.en:
Tabs. 4 , 5 , and 6 provide the full Recall@1/5/10 metrics for the retrieval settings of the experimental results in Sec. 4.3 .
For each dataset, we report both image-to-text (I2T) and text-to-image (T2I) retrieval, for all support modalities used to estimate the Procrustes alignment.
We compare SVD alignment alone, XBT (when available), and SLERP applied to the SVD-aligned embeddings with both the support-set selected weight α ^ \hat{\alpha} and the dataset-specific oracle α ⋆ \alpha^{\star} .
The tables also include the CLIP ViT-H/14 → \rightarrow CLIP ViT-B/32 setting, which has been adopted by [ 51 ] .
blocks.zh:
Tabs. 4, 5, 和 6 提供了完整的Recall@1/5/10 度量衡,用于第4.3项实验结果的检索设置.
对于每个数据集,我们报告图像对文本(I2T)和文本对图像(T2I)的检索,所有用于估计Procrustes对齐的支持模式.
我们只比较 SVD 校正, XBT( 在可用时), 和 SLERP 适用于 SVD 的嵌入, 既包括支持设置的选定重 α ^\ hat\ alpha} , 也包括数据集特有的 α\\\ α\ α\ star} 。
这些表格还包括CLIP VIT-H/14 →\右侧 CLIP VIT-B/32设定,该设定已被[51]采用.

blocks.en:
The detailed results confirm the trend of Tables 1 and 2 .
SVD provides a strong new-to-old alignment with no model retraining or gradient-based optimization, but it does not consistently achieve compatibility across model pairs, datasets, and support modalities.
SLERP improves the corresponding SVD endpoint in nearly all settings, and the gains extend beyond Recall@1 to Recall@5 and Recall@10.
This shows that interpolation not only improves the top-ranked item, but also produces a more compatible ranking over the old-model gallery.
blocks.zh:
详细结果证实了表1和表2的趋势。
SVD提供了强大的新旧配对,没有模式再培训或梯度优化,但它并没有一致地实现模型对子,数据集,支持模式之间的兼容性.
SLERP改进了几乎所有设置中相应的SVD端点,收益范围从Recall@1延伸到Recall@5和Recall@10.
这表明内插不仅改进了排名最高的项目,也产生了比旧型画廊更兼容的排名.

blocks.en:
The same pattern holds across same-family and cross-family pairs.
In the CLIP same-family settings, SLERP is consistently competitive with the training-based XBT baseline while requiring no compatibility training.
In the cross-family settings, including the difficult SigLIP1 → \rightarrow CLIP ViT-H/14 case, SLERP often turns incompatible SVD rows into compatible ones.
Across support modalities, text-only support remains the most stable overall, while image-only and joint support can be competitive for specific retrieval directions (I2T or T2I).
blocks.zh:
同样的模式存在于同一家庭和跨家庭的对子之间。
在CLIP同一家庭环境中,SLERP始终与基于培训的XBT基线具有竞争力,同时不需要兼容性培训.
在跨家族的环境下,包括困难的SigLIP1 →\rightarrow CLIP VIT-H/14 案件,SLERP经常将不兼容的SVD行变为兼容的.
在整个支持模式中,仅文本支持仍然是总体最稳定的,而仅图像支持和联合支持可以具有特定检索方向(I2T或T2I)的竞争能力.

blocks.en:
Tabs. 7 and 8 report the re-indexing setting, where the gallery is allowed to be re-indexed.
This setting differs from the compatibility evaluation in Eq. 15 , since the gallery is no longer fixed in the old-model space.
Instead, both query and gallery embeddings can be interpolated using the same SLERP weight: α = 0 \alpha=0 corresponds to the old-model representations, whereas α = 1 \alpha=1 corresponds to the SVD-aligned new-model representations.
blocks.zh:
Tabs. 7和8报告重新索引设置,允许重新索引画廊。
这个设置与Eq. 15中的兼容性评价不同,因为画廊不再固定在旧型号空间中.
相反,查询和画廊嵌入都可以使用相同的SLERP重量进行插值:α=0\alpha=0对应旧式表示法,而α=1\alpha=1对应SVD对齐的新式表示法.

blocks.en:
In this setting, the SVD endpoint is equivalent to evaluating the new model directly.
Because the orthogonal Procrustes map is applied to both query and gallery embeddings, it preserves all pairwise inner products and therefore leaves the retrieval ranking unchanged relative to the new model’s original representation space.
Consequently, the SVD results coincide with the new-model results.
blocks.zh:
在此设置中,SVD端点相当于直接评价新模型.
因为正弦 Procrustes地图既适用于查询嵌入,也适用于画廊嵌入,它保留了所有双向内置产品,因此相对于新模型的原始代表空间,检索排名保持不变.
因此,SVD结果与新模式结果相吻合。

blocks.en:
SLERP often improves over this endpoint, indicating that interpolation can be beneficial even when re-indexing is allowed.
These gains are particularly notable because SLERP requires no model retraining and, in several cases, matches or exceeds XBT, which requires compatibility training.
Overall, these results show that SLERP not only restores compatibility with an existing old-model index, but can also produce stronger interpolated representations when re-indexing is permitted.
blocks.zh:
SLERP经常在这个终点上有所改进,表明即使允许重新指数化,插值也可能是有益的.
这些成绩特别显著,因为SLERP不需要模式再培训,而且在某些情况下,需要匹配或超过XBT,这需要兼容性培训.
总的来说,这些结果显示,SLERP不仅恢复了与现有旧式索引的兼容性,而且在允许重新索引时也能产生更强的内插表示.

Fig. 8 examines how much target-distribution data is required to estimate a dataset-specific SLERP weight.
For each target-set fraction, we subsample the target benchmark using three random seeds and compute Recall@1 along the SLERP path.
The solid curves show the mean Recall@1 across seeds, and the shaded regions indicate one standard deviation.

对于每个目标集分数,我们用三个随机种子对目标基准进行子样本,并沿SLERP路径计算回调@1.
固态曲线显示平均值Recall@1横跨种子,阴影区域表示一个标准偏差.

blocks.en:
Across both model pairs, even small target subsets identify the same high-performing region of the SLERP curve.
Reducing the target-set budget increases the variance of the Recall@1 estimates, but the maximizer remains stable and close to that obtained using the full target set.
This suggests that a reliable dataset-specific interpolation weight can be estimated from a modest subset of the target distribution, without requiring evaluation on the full benchmark.
blocks.zh:
在整个两个模型配对中,即使是小目标子集也识别出SLERP曲线中相同的高性能区域.
减少设定目标的预算增加了 " 召回 " 1估计数的差异,但最大化值保持稳定,接近使用全部指标获得的数额。
这表明,可以对目标分布的一小部分进行可靠的数据集特定插值加权估计,而不需要对全部基准进行评价。

blocks.en:
This analysis is separate from the protocol used in the main results, where α ^ \hat{\alpha} is selected once on the CC3M validation set and then fixed for evaluation on Flickr30k, COCO, and NoCaps.
Its purpose is to assess a complementary scenario in which a small subset from the deployment distribution is available.
In this setting, the results indicate that such a subset is sufficient to estimate a reliable dataset-specific SLERP weight.
blocks.zh:
此分析与主要结果中使用的协议是分开的,其中在CC3M验证集中选择了α ^\hat~alpha}一次,然后固定在Flickr30k,COCO,NoCaps上进行评价.
其目的是评估一种补充情况,即从部署分配中提供一小部分。
在这个设定中,结果表明这样的子集足以估计一个可靠的数据集特定SLERP的权重.

blocks.en:
The geometric characterization in Sec. 3 is formulated with respect to an idealized retrieval-optimal direction q ∗ q^{\ast} , which is not observable in practice.
We therefore complement it with an empirical analysis at the level of individual queries, asking whether interior points of the evaluated SLERP arc provide retrieval benefits that neither endpoint provides.
This analysis uses query-level test labels and is intended only as an oracle upper bound; it does not constitute a deployable weight-selection procedure.
blocks.zh:
第3节中的几何特征是针对一个理想化的检索-最佳方向 q * q^{\ast}制定的,在实践中是看不到的。
因此,我们通过对个别查询进行经验分析来补充这一信息,询问评估的SLERP电弧的内部点是否提供了两个终点都无法提供的检索好处。
这种分析使用查询级测试标签,其用意仅为甲骨文上方约束;它不构成可部署的权重选择程序.

This experiment does not recover q ∗ q^{\ast} itself.
It tests two observable counterparts of Theorem 1 .
First, instantiating q ∗ q^{\ast} as a relevant item, the interior condition of the theorem holds for 99.87 % 99.87\% of queries, indicating that the residual direction between the old-model and aligned new-model queries consistently moves the query closer to its relevant items.
Second, at the level of the discrete retrieval event, interior weights yield Recall@1 successes unavailable at either endpoint for 1,408 1{,}408 queries and strictly improve the best relevant-item rank for 21.43 % 21.43\% of queries.
Whether a higher relevant-item similarity translates into a retrieval gain depends on the margin to non-relevant items, consistent with the margin-based certification in Appendix F .
Finally, the gap between the per-query oracle and the fixed support-set-selected weight indicates that the preferred interpolation position varies across queries.

blocks.en: Appendix N Alignment and Endpoint-Combination Baselines

blocks.en:
To identify the source of the improvements observed in the main experiments, we decompose the proposed approach into its three components: the alignment map, the operator that combines the two query representations, and the selection of the interpolation position.
We compare orthogonal Procrustes with non-isometric alignment maps, and SLERP with alternative ways of combining the old-model query u u and the aligned new-model query v v .
The old-model gallery is always left unchanged throughout the analysis.

为了确定在主要实验中观察到的改进的源头,我们把拟议方法分解成其三个组成部分:对齐图,将两个查询表达式结合起来的操作器,以及内插位置的选择.
我们比较了正交Procrustes与非异位对齐图,SLERP与旧型查询u u和对齐的新型查询v.
旧型画廊在整个分析过程中总是保持不变.

blocks.en:
All results cover the five model pairs, three retrieval datasets, three alignment-support modalities, and both retrieval directions of Sec. 4 , i.e., 45 45 configurations and 90 90 compatibility evaluations.
Every alignment map, regularization parameter, and interpolation parameter is estimated or selected only on the CC3M validation split used as alignment support set, separately for I2T and T2I Recall@1, and then used for evaluation on Flickr30k, COCO, and NoCaps.
Interpolation coefficients are selected over the grid { 0 , 0.1 , … , 1 } \{0,0.1,\ldots,1\} .
Compatibility is assessed with the empirical protocol of Eq. 15 .

所有结果包括五个模型对,三个检索数据集,三个对齐支持模式,以及Sec 4的两个检索方向,即45个45个配置和90个90个兼容评价.
每个对齐映射,规范化参数和内插参数仅在用作对齐支持集的CC3M验证分裂中进行估计或选择,分别用于I2T和T2I Recall@1,然后用于Flickr30k,COCO,NoCaps的评价.

blocks.en:
Tab. 10 shows that orthogonal Procrustes is the strongest alignment method among the evaluated ones.
The non-isometric maps, although more flexible on the support set, generalize substantially worse to the target benchmarks: affine alignment loses 15.35 15.35 mean Recall@1 points relative to Procrustes, ridge regression and one-sided CCA lose 11.32 11.32 , and whitened Procrustes loses 1.83 1.83 , with compatibility dropping from 45 / 90 45/90 to 11 11 , 14 14 , 14 14 , and 37 / 90 37/90 , respectively.
Because these maps rescale or shear the new-model representation, they distort the inner-product geometry that retrieval relies on, whereas an isometry preserves it.
The table also shows that alignment alone is not sufficient: SVD remains below the unchanged old-model query by 1.64 1.64 I2T and 0.49 0.49 T2I Recall@1 points on average, which is why it satisfies compatibility in only half of the evaluations.

Replacing the SVD endpoint by the fixed normalized midpoint raises mean I2T and T2I Recall@1 from 51.72 51.72 and 33.77 33.77 to 57.76 57.76 and 37.23 37.23 , a mean improvement of 4.75 4.75 points over SVD.
Relative to the unchanged old-model query, it improves I2T and T2I Recall@1 by 4.40 4.40 and 2.97 2.97 points, and it increases compatibility from 45 / 90 45/90 to 72 / 90 72/90 .
Since this baseline has no tunable weight and uses no validation data, this gain is attributable to the combination of the two endpoints.

SLERP improves mean Recall@1 over SVD by 4.80 4.80 points, only 0.05 0.05 more than the midpoint, while raising compatibility from 72 / 90 72/90 to 84 / 90 84/90 ; relative to the old-model query, it improves I2T and T2I Recall@1 by 4.36 4.36 and 3.12 3.12 points.
